package.name: rl_bridge
package.description:
ROS adapter for the reinforcement-learning navigation policy trained in rl_sim. Rebuilds the exact observation the policy was fitted to from live sensors (a reduced laser scan, carrots along a planned route, the EKF's twist), runs the exported actor with onnxruntime, and publishes the resulting body twist on cmd_vel_rl.
The policy is the primary controller and Nav2 sits below it in twist_mux as the fallback, so this node going silent hands the rover back to Nav2 rather than stopping it.
The observation layout, the velocity envelope and the action scaling live in contract.py and limits.py, which import no ROS and are the SAME code the simulator trains against. That is deliberate: a policy fed a vector assembled differently returns a plausible twist for a question nobody asked, with no error to notice.
Publishes no transforms. The EKF keeps odom -> base_link and AMCL keeps map -> odom, exactly as with Nav2.
